newsitem.title: USA: Dead man eaten by pet dogs in NY apartment.
newsitem.headline: Dead man eaten by pet dogs in NY apartment.

text.p: A 51-year-old New York City man, who died in his apartment over the Fourth of July holiday weekend, was eaten by his seven starving dogs, police said on Saturday.
Neighbours at the apartment building, on Manhattan's lower east side, said the dead man, who was not identified, had been ill with AIDS. He was last seen alive on Sunday or Monday, police said.
Police went to the apartment following complaints from the neighbours.
"Upon entering, police discovered that the seven dogs had consumed most of the victim's body. He apparently died and then they ate his body," a police spokesman said.
The animals, all mixed breeds, were taken to the Animal Care and Control Centre in Manhattan. It is not known if they will be destroyed or put up for adoption.
